summary: Iter30 thumbnail/photo-optimization tests: 9/9 backend pytest passed + 5/5 iter28 regression passed. Frontend EquipmentAdmin renders Elektronarzedzia tab; list payload measured at 1523 bytes for 4 items (drastic reduction confirmed). image_utils.make_thumbnail validated: 1500x1500 JPEG -> <1KB thumb (96px max, JPEG q=75). All POST/PUT for equipment/material/clothing_type now return thumb in 'photo' (no photo_thumb key in list responses). /single/{id} endpoints return full photo (>5000 chars) plus photo_thumb. Migration log observed: '[thumb-migration] nothing to do (all thumbnails present)' on backend restart (idempotent, all docs already migrated).
critical_code_review_comments: equipment.py update_equipment: photo_thumb is regenerated even when other fields are updated and photo not changed - fine because guarded by `if payload.photo is not None`. OK.
warehouse.py update_material uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) but then drops None values - if a caller explicitly sets photo=None to clear the photo, it will be silently ignored. Minor edge case.

clothing.py update_clothing_type uses model_dump() without exclude_unset, so None defaults could overwrite is_active=False to True. Pre-existing behaviour; the `if v is not None` filter mitigates but means is_active cannot be set to False/None via PUT. Already noted in prior iterations.
_migrate_thumbnails is non-blocking (asyncio.create_task) - good. Iterates with `async for` and yields every 10 items. Safe.
GZip middleware (minimum_size=500) plus thumb optimization compounds to ~95%+ payload reduction on list endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Elektronarzedzia tab renders, list payload 1523 bytes / 4 items confirmed)
